# Evolako

> Evolako installs home EV chargers in Serbia, mainly for people who live in apartment buildings, and also for houses, rented garages and businesses. A package is a charger (or a reinforced socket) with basic installation next to the distribution board, a MID sub-meter where needed and an optional monthly statement. Evolako does not sell electricity: the MID meter measures what the charger uses and the cost is passed on at the price from the EPS bill, without markup. Service area: all of Serbia. Languages: Serbian (Latin), English (/en/), Russian (/ru/).

## Packages and prices (RSD, as published on /paketi-i-cene)

Every package includes basic installation next to the distribution board: up to 2 m of cable, an RCD (FID) and a breaker. Anything beyond that is quoted after the on-site assessment, before any work starts.

- START — 39.000: a reinforced socket with a MID meter; works on an ordinary single-phase installation (2,3–3,7 kW)
- WALLBOX 11 kW — from 94.000; 104.000 with a MID meter, which is required when the charger runs on someone else's meter (a building's or a garage owner's)
- PLUS — 115.000 with a Type 2 socket, 127.000 with a 5 m cable; MID meter +10.000
- PREMIUM — 155.000; 195.000 with a PowerBoost meter (dynamic power management and charging from solar panels); MID meter +10.000
- ZGRADA (buildings) — from 96.000 per parking space: a shared line with MID metering for every user
- UGRADNJA (installing a charger you already have) — from 24.000

## How it works

- A rough estimate from photos is free; the on-site assessment (procena) costs 2.990 RSD and is credited in full against the installation if you go ahead
- The installation itself takes one working day; when a building assembly has to decide, the whole process usually takes 4–10 weeks
- Building paperwork: Evolako gives a technical description of the installation and templates (draft assembly decision, agenda item, owner's consent, answers to residents' questions); the residents decide and submit them — Evolako does not attend assemblies or run the procedure
- Optional subscription, 990 RSD per month: a monthly statement by the MID meter at the EPS price, priority service, the warranty kept for as long as the subscription runs, help when moving; the first 2 months cost 0 RSD and it can be cancelled in any month; the charger works without it
- Standard warranty: 2 years, on the equipment and the installation
- Replies within 48 h. Contact by messages only (no calls): +381 65 381 6083 on Viber, WhatsApp and Telegram (@evolako_rs); e-mail hello@evolako.com

- [Preporuka](https://www.evolako.rs/preporuka): referral — with a friend's code you get 2 more months of the subscription at 0 RSD
- [Medija kit](https://www.evolako.rs/medija-kit): facts, packages, texts and logos for media and partners
- [Politika privatnosti](https://www.evolako.rs/politika-privatnosti): privacy policy and terms of use

## Cities

Evolako works all over Serbia. Each city page shows the public chargers in and around the city (from the charger map), the hours of the EPS lower tariff there, the packages and how an installation goes.

- [All cities](https://www.evolako.rs/ugradnja-punjaca): home charger installation all over Serbia, the cities by region
- Belgrade: [Belgrade](https://www.evolako.rs/ugradnja-punjaca-beograd)
- Vojvodina: [Kikinda](https://www.evolako.rs/ugradnja-punjaca-kikinda), [Novi Sad](https://www.evolako.rs/ugradnja-punjaca-novi-sad), [Pančevo](https://www.evolako.rs/ugradnja-punjaca-pancevo), [Sombor](https://www.evolako.rs/ugradnja-punjaca-sombor), [Sremska Mitrovica](https://www.evolako.rs/ugradnja-punjaca-sremska-mitrovica), [Subotica](https://www.evolako.rs/ugradnja-punjaca-subotica), [Vršac](https://www.evolako.rs/ugradnja-punjaca-vrsac), [Zrenjanin](https://www.evolako.rs/ugradnja-punjaca-zrenjanin)
- Šumadija and Western Serbia: [Čačak](https://www.evolako.rs/ugradnja-punjaca-cacak), [Jagodina](https://www.evolako.rs/ugradnja-punjaca-jagodina), [Kragujevac](https://www.evolako.rs/ugradnja-punjaca-kragujevac), [Kraljevo](https://www.evolako.rs/ugradnja-punjaca-kraljevo), [Kruševac](https://www.evolako.rs/ugradnja-punjaca-krusevac), [Loznica](https://www.evolako.rs/ugradnja-punjaca-loznica), [Novi Pazar](https://www.evolako.rs/ugradnja-punjaca-novi-pazar), [Šabac](https://www.evolako.rs/ugradnja-punjaca-sabac), [Užice](https://www.evolako.rs/ugradnja-punjaca-uzice), [Valjevo](https://www.evolako.rs/ugradnja-punjaca-valjevo)

## Businesses and buildings

- [Punjači za firme](https://www.evolako.rs/punjaci-za-firme): chargers for businesses and buildings
- [Stambene zgrade](https://www.evolako.rs/punjaci-za-stambene-zgrade): chargers in apartment-building garages, for building managers
- [Novogradnja](https://www.evolako.rs/punjaci-za-novogradnju): new buildings and developers
- [Hoteli](https://www.evolako.rs/punjaci-za-hotele): hotels and apartments, charging for guests
- [Parking garaže](https://www.evolako.rs/punjaci-za-parking-garaze): parking garages and company car parks
- [Parkinzi](https://www.evolako.rs/punjaci-za-parkinge): guarded and long-term car parks
- [Auto saloni](https://www.evolako.rs/punjaci-za-auto-salone): car dealers and home chargers for their buyers
- [Službena vozila](https://www.evolako.rs/punjaci-za-sluzbena-vozila): company cars, charged at home and at the company car park
- [Kalkulator cene punjača](https://www.evolako.rs/kalkulator-cene-punjaca): what chargers cost for a building, a hotel or a company
- [Prijavi zgradu](https://www.evolako.rs/prijavi-zgradu): register a building's interest
